# Sextant ecosystem index

The fastest path from a question to the page that answers it. Generated from the
tree by `scripts/ecosystem_index.py`; run `just session-start` to check it.

## Start here

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md) — These are Sextant's operating rules (`AGENTS.md` at the commit in ORIGINS.md), kept word for word where they are generic. Passages that only make sense for Sextant's trading...
- [Manifest](docs/manifest.md) — What we do and where the practice comes from. Nothing enters the harness without a row. A practice we stop using is deleted; git keeps the history. `just prove` runs every proof...
- [Philosophy](docs/handbook/philosophy.md) — **[Sextant-specific]** How Sextant trades, condensed from the owner's finalized record (a private repository): northstar-lanes ADR-0003 at...
- [Practices](docs/handbook/practices.md) — *The working practices that survived the harvest. Each line names the record it comes from; a practice with no source is dropped.*
